Hanno City has two tourist information offices. Their closure dates and hours will change from April 11, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (inside Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry): Closed every Sunday (open on national holidays; closed on makeup holidays) and during year-end/new year period. Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

Hanno Station Tourist Information Office "Puratto Hanno": Closed during year-end/new year period and April 1–10, 2026 (closed for renovation). Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (weekdays, weekends, and holidays).

Note: Manhole cards and Eagle Bus passes will no longer be available at Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association.

For details, visit: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e8%a6%b3%e5%85%89%e6%a1%88%e5%86%85%e6%89%80%e4%bc%91%e6%a5%ad%e6%97%a5%e3%81%a8%e5%96%b6%e6%a5%ad%e6%99%82%e9%96%93%e5%a4%89%e6%9b%b4%e3%81%ae%e3%81%8a%e7%9f%a5%e3%82%89%e3%81%9b
